Each post compares versions of [greta](https://github.com/greta-dev/greta). A post's `run.R` holds all of the code that was measured: the models, the calls that were timed, and the settings. It installs each version with [{cross}](https://github.com/DavisVaughan/cross) and times it with [{bench}](https://bench.r-lib.org/), in a fresh R session per version, and the page shows that script in full, beside every result it produced.
